If you're looking for a smartwatch with fitness tracking, I'd focus on accurate heart-rate monitoring, workout tracking, GPS, sleep analysis, and battery life.

Here are some strong options depending on your phone and fitness goals.

Recommended smartwatches

Garmin Venu 4

Best for fitness tracking

Advanced workout metrics, GPS, recovery and sleep tracking. Up to 10–12 days of battery life.

$549.99

Shop

Apple Watch Series 12

Best for iPhone. Excellent heart-rate tracking, workouts, health monitoring and apps. Around one day of battery life.

Starting around $399

Samsung Galaxy Watch8

Good Android option for exercise, sleep, heart rate and everyday smartwatch features.

$329.99

Fitbit Versa 4

Affordable fitness-focused option for steps, heart rate, sleep and basic workout tracking.

$199.95

For dedicated fitness tracking, I'd lean toward the Garmin Venu 4. For a balance of fitness and smart features, Apple Watch or Samsung is a better fit.
